title: Implement backend limit checking system
description: Add complete infrastructure for checking task/project limits: constants, schema updates, helper functions, and quota query. Free users: 2 projects max, ~50 tasks max. Paid users with 'no-limits' feature: unlimited.
acceptance: Constants file with FREE_TASK_LIMIT (50) and FREE_PROJECT_LIMIT (2)
Schema updated: 'no-limits' feature added, 'no-task-limit' removed
checkTaskLimit(ctx, userAuthId) returns { current: number, max: number }
checkProjectLimit(ctx, userAuthId) returns { current: number, max: number }
getUserQuota query returns { taskCurrent, taskMax, projectCurrent, projectMax }
max == -1 for unlimited users
Uses Convex aggregates for efficient counting
All functions respect 'no-limits' feature flag
notes: This is the foundation for all limit enforcement. getUserQuota is only for account page display, not inline UI counters.

title: Enforce limits in create mutations
description: Update createTask and createProject mutations to check limits before allowing creation and throw LimitReached errors when limits are hit.
acceptance: createTask checks limit via checkTaskLimit before insert
createProject checks limit via checkProjectLimit before insert
Both throw ConvexError with type 'LimitReached' when current >= max
Error includes ctx: { current, max, resource } for UI consumption
Users with 'no-limits' feature (max = -1) bypass checks
Existing tests pass or are updated appropriately
notes: Error format: { type: 'LimitReached', msg: '[Resource] limit reached', ctx: { current, max, resource: 'tasks'|'projects' } }. Frontend catches these to show upgrade prompts.

title: Implement Stripe webhook handler
description: Create Convex HTTP endpoint to receive Stripe webhooks for payment events. Handle checkout completion (one-time and subscription) and subscription cancellation. Update user 'no-limits' feature based on payment status.
acceptance: HTTP endpoint at /api/stripe/webhook receives POST requests
Webhook signature verification using Stripe secret
Handles checkout.session.completed event: grants 'no-limits' feature
Handles customer.subscription.deleted event: revokes 'no-limits' feature
Distinguishes between one-time payment and subscription via metadata or mode
Updates users table via internal mutation
Returns 200 for successful processing, 400 for invalid signature
Logs events for debugging (can use console for now)
notes: Use Stripe SDK for signature verification. Webhook signing secret will be configured in Stripe dashboard. Consider storing Stripe customer ID on user record for future reference. For one-time payments, 'no-limits' is permanent; for subscriptions, it's active until cancelled.

title: Create upgrade/subscription page
description: Build complete upgrade page at /account/upgrade showing current tier, quota, and pricing options with Stripe payment links. Users can choose between subscription or one-time early supporter payment.
acceptance: Route exists at /account/upgrade (or /account/subscription)
Displays current tier (Free vs Supporter/Unlimited)
Shows quota via getUserQuota: 'X/Y tasks, X/Y projects'
Two pricing cards: Subscription and One-Time Early Supporter
Each card has button linking to Stripe payment link (URLs TBD/configurable)
Success state: shows confirmation when returning from Stripe (query param or state)
Upgrade page is accessible from authenticated routes
Good UX: clear benefits listed, mobile responsive
notes: Stripe payment links will be created manually in Stripe dashboard. Store URLs in environment variables or config. Success handling can be simple (check for ?success=true param or poll user features). Prices TBD - leave placeholder text.

title: Add limit counters and upgrade navigation
description: Add proactive UI elements showing remaining quota near create buttons with info icons that navigate to upgrade page. Users should always know how close they are to limits.
acceptance: Counter near 'Create Project' button: 'X/Y free projects' (or 'Unlimited' for paid)
Counter near 'Create Task' button: 'X/Y free tasks' (or 'Unlimited' for paid)
Info icons next to counters that link to /account/upgrade
Counters use checkTaskLimit/checkProjectLimit (or local equivalent)
Counters hidden or show 'Unlimited' when user has 'no-limits' feature
Counters update reactively when projects/tasks created or deleted
Good visual hierarchy: non-intrusive but visible
notes: Find 'Create Project' and 'Create Task' buttons in UI - likely in projects list page and task editor. May need to pass quota data down as props or use Convex query directly in components.

title: Add limit-reached error handling and support CTA
description: Handle LimitReached errors from backend with upgrade prompts, and add 'Support Development' button to empty tasks state.
acceptance: Catch LimitReached errors from createTask/createProject mutations
Show modal or toast with upgrade message when limit hit
Error UI includes current/max counts and CTA button to upgrade page
Good UX: clear, not annoying, easy to dismiss
'Support Development' button in empty 'today's tasks' block
Support button navigates to /account/upgrade
All navigation to upgrade page works correctly
notes: Empty tasks block likely in planner or home view. LimitReached error handling may need global error boundary or local try/catch in create actions. Consider using existing modal/toast components.

title: Stripe setup documentation and end-to-end testing
description: Document Stripe payment link creation, webhook configuration, and verify complete monetization flow works end-to-end in test mode.
acceptance: Documentation for creating Stripe payment links (subscription and one-time)
Documentation for webhook endpoint URL and secret configuration
Environment variables documented (webhook secret, payment link URLs)
Test: Free user hits task limit, sees upgrade prompt, clicks through to upgrade page
Test: Free user hits project limit (2), sees upgrade prompt
Test: Stripe test mode checkout completes, webhook grants 'no-limits' feature
Test: User with 'no-limits' can create unlimited tasks/projects
Test: Subscription cancellation webhook revokes 'no-limits' (if subscription)
All tests pass in development environment
deps: Add limit counters and upgrade navigation
Add limit-reached error handling and support CTA
notes: This is the final verification that everything works together. Use Stripe test mode and Stripe CLI for webhook testing. Document any gotchas or manual steps needed for production deployment.
